messages:
marta: copy draft uploaded: https://doc.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-micro-ux
marta: need a short copy pass + legal check on the benchmark claim, and to finalize CTA microcopy (Sandbox vs Workshop vs Sales) by Wed EOD
nick: skimmed. love the storytelling. suggestion: swap the benchmark line into a slim callout and add one sentence about test workload (300-600 tokens, batch size 8)
lina: tagging @anna-legal 4ac we currently say 'cost savings of 30-45%' in the callout. do we have a benchmark appendix to link? if not, hedge language
anna-legal: please change to 'saves up to 45% on inference cost' and add a numbered footnote to the methodology. also: any named customer quote needs explicit written permission
jamal: ops/dev note: we can support three routing targets: sandbox signups (immediate API key), workshop regs (Calendly + reminder), sales demo (qual form -> CRM). which should be primary?
kevin-growth: recommend primary = sandbox (lower friction), secondary = workshop (educational), tertiary = sales demo (high intent). we can A/B the primary CTA placement: top banner vs inline code block
design: I'll produce two hero comps and a compact 3-line code block for the inline try. want the code sample to be copy/paste-friendly and visually compact
sarah: measurement ask: track sandbox_key_created, workshop_registered, demo_request_submitted. separate events for banner CTA and inline code 'Run in sandbox' clicks
greg: add a tiny latency distribution row under the callout: p50/p95/p99 to avoid single-number interpretation
chris: SEO/ops: if we run workshop, add structured event markup and include the event date on the blog; Calendly links should include utm params
marta: can we include a micro-qualifier on the demo form: company size and use-case? sales wants it to prioritize leads
kevin-growth: yes, add two fields: company_size (dropdown) and primary_use_case (free text). auto-score in CRM: >100 employees + gen-ai use_case -> high priority
anna-legal: reminder re: logos/quotes: send quote text + screenshot and the customer contact to legal@redwood.ai. allow 48-72 hours for approval
ops-bot: Checklist created: create sandbox landing, calendar workshop page, demo form, GTM events (blog_banner_cta, blog_inline_run, sandbox_key_created, workshop_reg, demo_form_submit), and verify DNS
jamal: I'll scaffold sandbox landing + workshop page and post preview by Tue afternoon
design: code snippet proposal (3 lines):
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client("SANDBOX_KEY")
print(c.generate("Summarize our product in one sentence"))
```
will provide a monospace screenshot for the hero area
lina: updated doc with 'saves up to 45%' and footnote placeholder. @greg please pin the methodology link, @anna-legal confirm quote permission steps
marta: timeline: copy freeze Wed EOD, design to deliver hero + code screenshot Thu 9am PT, ops to hand off preview to growth for nurture mapping Thu noon
kevin-growth: I'll draft a 4-email nurture for workshop registrants and an onboarding email flow for sandbox signups once assets are available
sarah: let's ensure GTM tags split by variant: utm_variant=banner vs utm_variant=inline so we can compare activation rates
marta: owners recap:
- legal: final benchmark phrasing + quote permissions (anna-legal)
- design: hero comps + compact code screenshot (design)
- ops/web: sandbox + workshop landing + GTM (jamal / ops-bot)
- growth: nurture sequences + demo routing (kevin-growth)
- eng/product: benchmark appendix and latency distro (greg)
- content/SEO: event markup + slug (chris / lina)
reconvene Wed 10am PT for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
